about: LaptopRecs starter catalog (2026-11-12): ultrabooks and everyday laptops, gaming, business, creator and mobile-workstation laptops, 2-in-1s, Chromebooks and MacBooks released 2023-2026, approved by the owner 2026-11-12. One product per model and generation: RAM, storage, screen and colour options of one model share an entry; CPU or GPU tiers share one only when the maker sells them under one model name. Names are read on the maker's own pages (Apple support tech specs, Lenovo PSREF, Microsoft Learn tech specs, dell.com, hp.com/QuickSpecs, asus.com/rog.asus.com, Acer/MSI spec sheets, maker newsrooms); a model code or year in parentheses is how the maker tells same-named generations apart. Columns: shape = category, balance = processor options, core = graphics options, surface = main display options, weight = weight as the maker states it (lightest configuration). Values come from the pages in sources; blank where not read there. Razer, Samsung, LG and Gigabyte pages were mostly bot-blocked, so their spec values were read from search previews of the maker pages or maker newsrooms; Razer weights are left blank. Added 2026-11-12: MacBook Air 13 (M1) and MacBook Pro 16 (M1 Pro/Max), released 2020/2021, because 3+ first-hand reviews from distinct owners were held for each (owner standing rule); names and specs read on Apple's tech-specs pages. Added 2026-11-12 (second sweep run): MacBook Pro 14 (M1 Pro/Max), MacBook Pro 13 (M1), MacBook Pro 13 (M2) and MacBook Air 13 (M2), each with 3+ held first-hand reviews from distinct owners (owner standing rule); names and specs read on Apple's tech-specs pages. Also added: Lenovo Legion 5i Gen 10 (PSREF "Legion 5 15IRX10", 11 held first-hand authors); its spec sheet text was not machine-readable, so its specs are blank.
